data.title: Canal Heights 2
data.about:
Discover the enchanting Canal Heights 2 lifestyle at Business Bay, unveiled by Damac Properties. This development offers a range of living spaces, including studios, 1 & 2 bedroom apartments, and super luxury duplexes with 3 & 4 bedrooms. With its high-rise design, remarkable exterior, and captivating interior aesthetics, this project promises a new and refined waterfront lifestyle beyond your expectations.

This exclusive lifestyle experience begins anew with this luxurious development situated in the heart of Business Bay, Dubai. It seamlessly connects you to popular destinations, business districts, commercial centers, and shopping malls. The mesmerizing views from your residence enhance your quality of life, elevating it to a new level of elegance and sophistication.

This development embodies the essence of Blue Topaz, drawing inspiration from its designs and architecture. It perfectly reflects Damac's signature luxury style, radiating through its designs and atmosphere. The meticulously crafted lifestyle seamlessly blends shimmering colors, flowing textures, and flawless forms, creating a serene environment that epitomizes elegance.

location_tile.title: Welcome To Canal Heights 2
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Canal Heights 2 is located in the thriving financial neighborhood of Business Bays, flanked by other fashionable high-rises, contemporary apartment complexes, and prominent hotels. This property is in the heart of Dubai, with convenient access to the city's major attractions via various transit options.

  • 07 Minutes Burj Khalifa
  • 07 Minutes Dubai Mall
  • 14 Minutes Dubai Healthcare City
  • 16 Minutes Dubai International Airport
